Defines the delay after which the animation is applied to submobjects. A lag_ratio ofn.nnmeans the next animation will play whennnn%of the current animation has played.
Defaults to 0.0, meaning that all animations will be played together.

This does not influence the total runtime of the animation. Instead the runtime
of individual animations is adjusted so that the complete animation has the defined
run time.
